Case II: Knapsack That Can Exactly Fit the Item
Since the next knapsack has a capacity of 4 units, it can exactly fit the TV. So, we'll update the corresponding cell to reflect this value.

blocks.alt: Knapsack With Less Capacity than the TV Can't Contain It

blocks.content: As the previous value was 0, the total profit will solely come from the TV, making the cell's value 150.
